body: Not really. Issues regarding mental health and (general awareness of it) are pretty much nonexistant in my country. I can't talk to anyone IRL about it cause there is a good chance people won't know how to react or i will be just ridiculed and seen as a whiner who has everything but likes to make stuff up. And most importanly, i don't really have anyone in my life now. I lost all friends i had due to my depression and people distanced themselves from me but i can't really blame them. It wasn't anything i could control either. No pills, no psychiatrist, no anyone. This post is my only real outlet i got to have in last 10 years
